text:
maya: Heads-up — incoming customer request to onboard Sunbird-24B for Helix Health. They want private deployment (VPC) + INT8 quantization for cost. HIPAA-ish workload. Can we triage viability?

samir: thanks — any perf/latency SLOs from the customer?

maya: customer asks: tail latency <120ms/token @ 32k context, sustained 40 concurrent sessions. Also wants deterministic logits for auditing.

alex: 24B + INT8 on T4s may be tight for that latency. Need to test O2 vs O3 kernels + KV caching. I'll run an initial quant smoke.

alex: ```bash
./quant_eval.sh --model sunbird-24b --scheme awq --bits 8 --batch 1 --seq 2048
```

alex: quick smoke results: "mem ok, sample latency 145ms/token @seq2048 (no caching)" — so with no cache we're ~20-25% off target.

dina: main question for prioritization: is Helix paying for Dedicated or Private contract? if private + enterprise, escalate.

maya: Helix signaled interest in annual Dedicated + private control plane. Sales is looping in legal for BAAs. I'd mark this high-priority. :eyes: 

eva: for quality gating we should run our eval suite against production prompts + safety checks. Suggest running: 
```yaml
eval_config:
  suites: [medical-qa, hallucination-check, rouge-baseline]
  baseline_model: phoenix-30b-fp16
  metrics: [accuracy, medically_critical_false_positive_rate]
```

samir: +1. Also need regression thresholds — if accuracy drops >2% on medical-qa, block shipping.

alex: next steps for me: 1) rerun quant with prefix KV caching enabled, 2) test awq vs q4f16, 3) collect logits diff vs phoenix-30b. ETA ~6h.

dina: i'll flag infra to reserve two gpu nodes for smoke runs and open a private onboarding ticket.

maya: can someone add auditability check — reproducible RNG seeds + deterministic tokenization? that's a compliance ask.

eva: can do. I'll add a deterministic-run wrapper to eval-runner and log PRNG seeds + tokenizer hash.

ci-bot: build 3842 started for quant-pipeline (alex). Running on runner-ml-03.

alex: noted. I'll drop results in the onboarding ticket and ping here when I have latency + metric diffs.

maya: perfect. tagging @sales and @security offline. thanks team.
